Some meetings leave behind memories that last forever! Enjoy "Tum Kitne Din Baad Mile" from the classic Bollywood film The Great Gambler (1979), featuring the legendary Amitabh Bachchan and the glamorous Zeenat Aman. Beautifully sung by Asha Bhosle, this delightful melody captures the charm, romance and musical brilliance of 70s Hindi cinema.
